newsitem.title: USA: U.S. orders ex-Auschwitz guard deported.
newsitem.headline: U.S. orders ex-Auschwitz guard deported.

text.p: A federal court ordered a 75-year-old Michigan man deported for serving as a guard at Nazi prison camps, the Justice Department said on Monday.

Chief U.S. Immigration Judge Michael Creppy found that Ferdinand Hammer, who lives in Sterling Heights, Michigan, participated in persecuting people at the Auschwitz concentration camp in Nazi-occupied Poland and at Sachsenhausen outside Berlin in 1944 and 1945.
He also found that Hammer guarded prisoners on transports between the two camps in 1945, when the Nazis left Auschwitz ahead of the arrival of Soviet troops.
Captured German documents showed that Hammer was a member of the Waffen SS, judged a criminal organisation at the Nuremburg trials after the Second World War.
Last May, a U.S. District Court stripped Hammer of his U.S. citizenship on grounds that the retired foundry supervisor lied about his role in the war.
